combatStatusList.classification: Conditional status overflow reproduced in a browser fixture; reporter exact area and native client reproduction remain unconfirmed
combatStatusList.staticCause: The active battle UI constrains each status list to 122px and explicitly enables overflow:auto. Content exceeding that height can produce a scrollbar.

cssEvidence.note: BATTLE_UI_TEST_V01 block; the following comment identifies the presentation proposal as 20261027.
The earlier unscoped #combat_ui_conditions rule has height:600px; the scoped battle rule overrides it with 122px.
The containing ally/enemy panels have height:440px and overflow:hidden; status content begins at top:300px.
The later battle font rule retains font-size:20px and line-height:25px without removing the 122px height or overflow:auto.

combatStatusList.capacityObservation: Five 25px line boxes require 125px, exceeding the 122px viewport. The exact active-effect count that triggers scrolling depends on the generated breaks and rendered line boxes; this audit does not claim a rendered threshold.
combatStatusList.minimalChangeDirection: First inspect redundant blank rows and the final br, then adjust the status layout within the existing frame if needed. Setting overflow:hidden alone would risk hiding status information.
combatStatusList.unresolved: The user's exact scrollbar location and failing active-effect combination have not been identified.
